Bug_Title: USELESS_STRING: Invocation of toString on an array (DMI_INVOKING_TOSTRING_ON_ARRAY)
Bug_Details:
The code invokes toString on an array, which will generate a fairly useless result
such as [C@16f0472. Consider using Arrays.toString to convert the array into a readable
String that gives the contents of the array. See Programming Puzzlers, chapter 3, puzzle 12.
Bug_Explanation: The code invokes toString on an array, which results in a memory address representation rather than the array's contents. This is a common mistake when attempting to print or log an array directly.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBug' triggers the bug by calling the 'showBug' method with an integer array, which incorrectly converts the array to a memory address string instead of its actual contents. The assertion expects a correctly formatted array string, causing the test to fail.
